Álvarez Meeting Report: What the Recorded Sources Establish

Published 28 August 2026 · Updated 6 September 2026 Premier League TV96 Live Editorial Team Sourced news summary and analysis · 4 min read
Back to News & Guides

Archive summary: the reporting below reflects the dated sources listed at the end. Interpretive sections are TV96 Live analysis, not independent or exclusive reporting.

Julián Álvarez's future at Atlético Madrid has entered a decisive stage after the Argentine forward and his representatives reportedly held a late-night meeting lasting more than five hours to discuss his next move.

Arsenal remain one of the main clubs linked with the 26-year-old, while Atlético Madrid continue to insist that they will not negotiate a transfer with Barcelona.

The situation has left Álvarez facing two realistic possibilities as the summer transfer window approaches its conclusion: remain at Atlético Madrid and rebuild his relationship with the club, or seriously consider a return to the Premier League with Arsenal.

Five-Hour Meeting Over Álvarez's Future

According to Cadena SER, Álvarez held a meeting with members of his family, his representative and legal advisers that continued into the early hours of the morning.

The discussions are reported to have lasted for more than five hours as those close to the Argentina international considered the options available before the transfer deadline.

The meeting underlines how complicated the situation has become, particularly after Atlético Madrid made their position regarding Barcelona increasingly clear.

Álvarez has previously been strongly linked with the Catalan club, but Atlético have publicly stated that they will not enter into negotiations with their La Liga rivals.

Arsenal Emerging as the Main Alternative

With Barcelona effectively removed from the picture, Arsenal have become the most prominent alternative destination for Álvarez should he decide to leave Madrid.

Sky Sports has reported that the forward is now considering a possible move to Arsenal, although the Premier League side are believed to view completing the transfer as extremely difficult.

Arsenal have maintained an interest in Álvarez for some time and Sky Sports described ongoing dialogue between their sporting director and chief executive.

The Gunners' interest reflects their desire to strengthen their attacking options with a player capable of operating both as a central striker and in deeper attacking positions.

However, interest alone does not mean a deal is close. Atlético's valuation, Álvarez's personal preference and the limited time remaining in the transfer window all represent major obstacles.

Atlético Refuse to Negotiate with Barcelona

Atlético Madrid's board has publicly backed the club's decision not to negotiate the sale of Álvarez to Barcelona.

The Spanish club has made a distinction between normal transfer-market negotiations and its specific position regarding Barcelona.

Atlético have stressed that they remain willing to conduct professional transfer discussions in general, but insist that there will be no negotiations with Barcelona over Álvarez.

That position has significantly changed the landscape surrounding the striker's future and is one of the reasons Arsenal's name has returned to the centre of the discussion.

Analysis: why a reported possibility is not an agreement

A buyer would need to agree terms with the selling club and the player. A reported preference alone does not settle either question. The earlier version included a specific asking price that the recorded sources did not establish; that figure has been removed.

Training Absence Explained

Álvarez has also missed Atlético training sessions during a period of intense speculation around his future.

However, reports from Sky Sports have stressed that his absence on Wednesday and Thursday was due to illness and a poor night's sleep rather than a transfer-related protest.

The distinction is important because the transfer speculation has naturally led to questions about whether his training absence was linked directly to negotiations.

Current reporting does not support that conclusion.

Decision Time for Álvarez

The next few days could therefore determine whether Álvarez remains in Madrid or makes a dramatic return to English football.

Arsenal are interested, Atlético will not negotiate with Barcelona, and the player and his representatives have now spent hours discussing the available options.

Remaining at Atlético would require Álvarez to move beyond a turbulent summer and focus again on Diego Simeone's team.

Choosing Arsenal would mean returning to the Premier League and joining a club competing at the top end of English and European football.

The cited reports did not announce a completed transfer or an agreement between Arsenal and Atlético Madrid.

But with the transfer deadline approaching, Álvarez's future has become one of the major stories to watch during the final days of the window.

Sources / Further Reading

Cadena SER; Sky Sports
